blocks.text: ANTALYA, Turkey — The UN’s COP31 climate talks enter their endgame Friday, with countries sharply divided over a draft deal lacking any mention of planet-heating fossil fuels, threatening to push the negotiations into overtime. Negotiators from nearly 200 countries were scrambling to bridge their differences after two weeks of talks in the Turkish Mediterranean city of Antalya, but the summit appears poised to spill into the weekend. The talks come with a series of stark reminders of the urgency of climate action, from heat waves in Europe and devastating floods in Nepal to a record-breaking El Niño wreaking more havoc around […]...
